title: Moseley's law
caption: A Kα X-ray comes from an L electron filling a K vacancy; the K electron left behind screens one unit of charge, so E ≈ 10.2 eV × (Z − 1)². For copper (Z = 29): 10.2 × 28² eV = 8 keV. Moseley used this to order the elements by atomic number.
alt: Kα energy against atomic number, a curve rising as Z minus 1 squared, with copper marked at 8.0 kiloelectronvolts.
description: √E against Z is a straight line: each element's place in the table is fixed by its nuclear charge.
